title: antirrhinum majus var. faurei
intro: Antirrhinum majus var. faurei, commonly known as the Yellow Snap Dragon, is a variety of flowering plant in the snapdragon family (Scrophulariaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety, making it a popular ingredient in calming teas and infusions. The health benefits of Antirrhinum majus var. faurei include its ability to act as a sedative, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anxiolytic and anti-inflammatory effects.
